details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced a significant net outflow of $148.7 million on September 30, marking the end of a nine-day period of continuous inflows. Ethereum ETFs also recorded a net outflow of $59.6 million on the same day. This indicates a recent shift in investor behavior in the institutional crypto market.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $148.7M Outflow, Ending Nine-Day Inflow Streak

details: MetaMask, a popular cryptocurrency wallet provider, has begun to proactively exit affected Ethereum validators within its non-custodial staking operations, particularly those in the Lido protocol. This action is a precautionary measure in response to an "ongoing security incident" affecting part of its infrastructure. MetaMask has stated that no immediate threat to user wallets has been identified.
title: MetaMask Exits Ethereum Validators Amid Undisclosed Security Incident

details: Bitwise Asset Management has launched the Bitwise NEAR ETF (NRR) on NYSE Arca, becoming the first US spot exchange-traded product to offer direct exposure to the NEAR Protocol. The fund plans to stake its NEAR tokens in-house, with potential staking rewards accruing to shareholders through an increase in the fund's net asset value.
title: Bitwise Debuts First US Spot NEAR ETF with Staking Rewards

details: Robinhood has announced plans to introduce perpetual futures trading for eligible US customers on eight cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA), Chainlink (LINK), and Hyperliquid (HYPE). Bitcoin and Ethereum contracts will offer up to 10x leverage, while the other six will be capped at 3x leverage. The rollout is anticipated in the coming months.
title: Robinhood to Launch 10x Crypto Perpetual Futures for US Traders
